cohort: The study included all pregnant women who delivered or had a maternal death in the US between 2004 and 2014.
finding: Women diagnosed with Ankylosing Spondylitis have an increased risk of obstetric complications including cesarean delivery, gestational diabetes, and placenta previa, as well as an increased risk of small-for-gestational-age neonates and intrauterine fetal death.
mod_finding: Women with Ankylosing Spondylitis had a higher rate of cesarean delivery compared to those without AS.
